title: Commercial loan application
purpose: Identify the borrowing parties, collateral and requested financing.
period: Current signed application
criteria: Exact legal names, entity type and ownership are complete.
Loan amount, purpose and collateral are identified.
Disclosure questions are answered; authorized signers sign and date.
Borrower and guarantor roles match the accepted LOI and legal documents.

title: Accepted LOI / term sheet
purpose: Document the proposed terms and acceptance.
period: Latest accepted version, including all pages
criteria: Borrower, guarantors, property and proposed terms are correct.
Required acceptance signatures and dates are present.
Handwritten edits are acknowledged and subsequent changes reconciled.
Final credit approval is tracked separately from LOI acceptance.

title: Loan purpose / cash-out explanation
purpose: Explain how loan proceeds will be used.
period: Current proposed sources and uses
criteria: Uses and recipients of proceeds are identified.
Amounts reconcile with existing balances, costs and requested proceeds.
Unexplained differences are resolved.
condition: Cash-out is requested or the application does not adequately explain the use of proceeds.

title: Business membership & account agreement
purpose: Complete lender-required entity account setup.
period: Current lender forms
criteria: Entity name and authorized signers match legal documents.
Required signatures and dates are present.
Lender confirms required accounts are opened.
condition: Required by the lender’s membership/account policy.

title: Trust / fiduciary account agreement
purpose: Complete account setup for an applicable trust.
period: Current lender forms
criteria: Trust name and acting trustees match trust documents.
Trustee authority and required signatures are verified.
Required account setup is confirmed.
condition: A trust is a borrower or guarantor and the lender requires a fiduciary account.

title: Year-end financial statements & business tax returns
purpose: Support the borrowing entity’s historical financial position and income.
period: 2023–2025 year-end financials and complete returns; lender confirms required years
criteria: Correct entity and all requested years are covered.
Returns include schedules and amendments; financials include income statements and balance sheets.
Balance sheets balance; material trends and tax-to-book differences are explained.
Tax verification reconciles to the submitted returns; a documented filing exception is required for missing returns.

title: Current YTD financial statements
purpose: Show the borrowing entity’s current performance and position.
period: Latest available YTD income statement and matching balance sheet
criteria: Income statement start/end dates and balance-sheet as-of date are clear.
Entity and accounting basis are consistent.
Statements meet lender freshness policy.
Unusual income, expenses, distributions and related-party balances are explained.

title: Tax extension / filing-status evidence
purpose: Explain a requested return that is not yet available.
period: Each missing requested tax year
criteria: Missing year and filing status are identified.
Extension or non-filing evidence is supplied as applicable.
Current financials accompany the request.
Lender records whether the exception permits underwriting to proceed.
condition: A requested return is unavailable or has not been filed.

title: Business debt schedule
purpose: Disclose borrowing obligations and commitments.
period: Current signed and dated schedule
criteria: All loans and credit facilities are disclosed.
Creditor, balance, payment, rate, maturity and collateral are identified.
Balances and payments reconcile with financial statements and credit evidence.
Contingent obligations and material discrepancies are explained.

title: Borrower real estate schedule (SREO)
purpose: Identify properties vested in the borrowing entity.
period: Current signed and dated schedule
criteria: Correct owning entity and ownership interests are shown.
Property income, debt and payments are identified.
Subject property and totals reconcile with the application and financials.
If no properties apply, provide a signed N/A declaration.

title: Borrower bank & brokerage statements
purpose: Verify entity cash, investments and account activity.
period: Latest three consecutive statement periods for all entity accounts; lender confirms dates
criteria: Account ownership matches the borrower.
All pages and requested consecutive periods are supplied.
Balances reconcile with financials, allowing explained timing differences.
Restrictions, pledged assets and material unexplained transfers are reviewed.
If no accounts exist, provide an explicit declaration for lender review.

title: Borrower Form 4506-C
purpose: Authorize verification of business tax returns.
period: Current accepted form covering requested tax years
criteria: Taxpayer, return type, years and recipient information are correct.
Signer has authority; required signatures and dates are present.
Signature method is accepted by the lender and IVES provider.
Authorization is within the applicable submission window.

title: Business tax transcripts / TRV
purpose: Independently verify submitted business returns.
period: Same years as the requested business returns
criteria: Taxpayer and years match the requirement.
Transcript results reconcile with returns.
Rejections, unavailable records and differences are resolved.
Lender records its review; authorization alone is insufficient.

title: Business credit report
purpose: Review entity credit history and undisclosed obligations.
period: Current under lender policy
criteria: Report identifies the correct entity.
Debts, payment history and adverse records are reviewed.
Material discrepancies reconcile with application and debt schedule.
Exceptions and reviewer conclusions are documented.

title: Formation, ownership & signing authority
purpose: Establish the entity’s identity, ownership and authority to borrow.
period: Current governing documents and all relevant amendments
criteria: Applicable formation and governing documents are complete and executed.
Legal name, ownership/control and authorized signers reconcile across the package.
EIN evidence or applicable explanation is supplied.
Lender verifies legal status and applicable beneficial-owner information.
Apply current customer-due-diligence rules; do not universally require a FinCEN BOI filing.

title: Personal financial statement
purpose: Summarize each individual guarantor’s financial support.
period: Current signed statement; self-prepared attachment within 30 days for this template
criteria: Assets, liabilities, income and contingent obligations are disclosed.
Totals reconcile and joint/partial ownership is clear.
Required declarations and signatures are complete.
Self-prepared attachments include completed lender-form identity, declarations and signatures.
Cash, retirement assets, securities and entity interests are distinguished.

title: Guarantor real estate schedule (SREO)
purpose: Support the guarantor’s real estate income, equity and debt.
period: Current signed and dated schedule
criteria: Ownership percentages and legal owners are identified.
Values, income, expenses, balances and payments are supported.
Schedule reconciles with PFS and tax schedules.
Personally owned and entity-owned properties are distinguished without double counting.

title: Guarantor personal tax returns
purpose: Verify reported income and identify recurring obligations.
period: Complete 2023–2025 returns; lender confirms required years
criteria: Correct taxpayer and all requested years are covered.
All schedules and amendments are included.
Recurring income and losses are identified; unusual gains/losses explained.
Income reconciles with PFS and tax verification results.

title: K-1s & supporting tax schedules
purpose: Support income and ownership from related entities.
period: Each applicable entity for the requested three tax years
criteria: Applicable interests in the tax returns are supported.
Entity, recipient and year match; ownership reconciles.
Taxable pass-through income is distinguished from cash distributions.
Losses and additional funding obligations are considered.
condition: Returns disclose partnership, S-corporation, trust or other applicable pass-through interests.

title: W-2 statements
purpose: Support employment income relied on in underwriting.
period: Three requested tax years
criteria: Correct taxpayer and employers are covered.
Wages reconcile with returns.
Employment changes and material variances are explained.
condition: Employment income is relevant to the guarantor’s financial support.

title: Recent pay statements
purpose: Verify current employment income.
period: Three most current paystubs
criteria: Employee, employer and pay dates are identifiable.
Gross/net pay and year-to-date earnings are shown.
Pay periods demonstrate continuity.
Variable pay and discrepancies are reviewed separately.
condition: Employment income is relevant to the guarantor’s financial support.

title: Guarantor bank, investment & retirement statements
purpose: Substantiate assets reported on the personal financial statement.
period: Latest three consecutive statement periods; lender confirms dates
criteria: Correct individual/trust ownership and all pages/periods are verified.
Balances support the corresponding PFS categories.
Unrestricted cash is distinguished from retirement and pledged assets.
Access restrictions and margin debt are considered.
Entity assets are not automatically counted as personal cash.

title: Guarantor Form 4506-C
purpose: Authorize verification of guarantor tax returns.
period: Current accepted form covering requested tax years
criteria: Taxpayer, return type, years and recipient details are correct.
Required signatures, date and capacity are valid.
Execution method is accepted by lender/provider.
Authorization covers the intended verification and submission window.

title: Guarantor tax transcripts / TRV
purpose: Independently verify each guarantor’s submitted returns.
period: Same years as requested personal returns
criteria: Taxpayer and years are verified from contents, not filename.
Results reconcile with the personal returns.
Mismatches, missing results and rejections are resolved.
Lender records its review.

title: Government-issued identification
purpose: Verify the identity of the individual guarantor.
period: Current identification acceptable under lender policy
criteria: Identification is legible and acceptable under lender policy.
Validity/expiry is checked.
Identity matches the application; name differences are resolved.
Verification is recorded without unnecessary disclosure of identifiers.

title: Personal credit report
purpose: Review guarantor credit history and obligations.
period: Current under lender policy
criteria: Correct individual and appropriate authorization are verified.
Undisclosed debts and adverse credit history are evaluated.
Debt payments are included in the financial analysis.
Discrepancies and exceptions are documented.

title: Sponsor resume / biography
purpose: Assess relevant ownership and property-management experience.
period: Current biography
criteria: Relevant ownership and management experience is described.
Material claims are supportable.
Experience gaps are assessed against property complexity and management arrangements.

title: Trust agreement / certification
purpose: Establish trustee authority and access to trust assets.
period: Current trust documents and relevant amendments
criteria: Exact trust and current acting trustees are identified.
Lender/legal reviewer confirms guarantee or borrowing authority.
Assets relied upon are legally accessible as required.
Certification is accepted only where sufficient for the lender’s review.
condition: A trust guarantees the loan or trust assets are relied upon.

title: Affiliated-entity financial support
purpose: Substantiate material support from related businesses.
period: Current financials, debt and distributions for each relevant entity
criteria: Ownership and claimed support reconcile with the PFS and returns.
Financial statements, debt and distributions substantiate available support.
Transfer restrictions and competing obligations are assessed.
Income and assets are not double counted.
condition: Repayment or guarantor support materially depends on another entity.

title: Entity-guarantor financial & legal package
purpose: Review a non-individual guarantor using the applicable entity documents.
period: Requested historical years and current interim period
criteria: Entity financials, tax evidence, debt schedule and accounts are supplied as applicable.
Formation/governing documents and signing authority are verified.
Tax status and any filing exception are documented.
Available support and competing obligations are assessed.
condition: A corporation, LLC or partnership is a guarantor; apply the trust request separately for trusts.

title: Appraisal engagement / order
purpose: Establish the lender-approved appraisal scope and provider.
period: Current assignment
criteria: Property and scope are correct.
Lender-approved engagement, appraiser qualifications and independence are verified.
Required valuation premises, intended use and intended user are specified.

title: Final appraisal report
purpose: Support the collateral valuation used for underwriting.
period: Latest complete report; effective date acceptable to lender
criteria: Correct property/unit, parcel and property rights are appraised.
Intended user/use and effective date are appropriate.
Complete analysis and appraiser certification are present.
Valuation assumptions, leases, occupancy and condition are reviewed.
Required valuation bases are included; collateral value is distinct from insurance replacement cost.

title: Appraisal review & acceptance
purpose: Document the lender’s review of the valuation.
period: Review of the exact report version used for approval
criteria: Review identifies the appraisal version and effective date.
Credibility and material assumptions are evaluated.
Accepted value and conditions are documented.
Deficiencies are corrected or formally resolved.
Lender acceptance covers the report actually used in underwriting.

title: Revised appraisal / update
purpose: Resolve a change to the valuation report.
period: Latest revision and corresponding review
criteria: Revision reason and predecessor report are identifiable.
Changed conclusions and assumptions are explained.
Lender review explicitly covers the revised report.
Underwriting is updated where affected.
condition: The appraisal is revised or an update is required.

title: Site inspection report & photographs
purpose: Verify observed property use, occupancy and condition.
period: Current lender-accepted inspection
criteria: Property, inspection date and inspector are identified.
Access limitations are disclosed.
Occupancy/use, condition, repairs, access and surroundings are documented with photos.
Differences from the application/appraisal are escalated.
Visual inspection does not substitute for required environmental or engineering reports.

title: Parcel / unit identification support
purpose: Confirm the exact collateral being pledged.
period: Current parcel and legal-description evidence
criteria: Address, unit, parcel and legal description reconcile.
Title/survey and appraisal identify the same collateral.
Parent tract is distinguished from any individual condominium unit.

title: Inspection / appraisal follow-up evidence
purpose: Resolve material findings before acceptance or funding.
period: Evidence addressing each outstanding finding
criteria: Each finding has appropriate supporting evidence or specialist review.
Repairs, reinspection and access limitations are resolved as required.
Lender records resolution and any remaining funding conditions.
condition: Inspection or appraisal identifies unresolved repairs, inconsistencies or other material findings.

title: Current rent roll
purpose: Support current rental income and occupancy.
period: Current as-of date acceptable to lender
criteria: Property, tenants, units and vacant areas are identified.
Lease dates, rent, reimbursements and concessions are shown.
Totals and occupancy reconcile with leases and operating statements.

title: Property operating statements
purpose: Support recurring property cash flow.
period: 2023–2025 full years and current YTD; lender confirms periods
criteria: Property and reporting periods are identified.
Base rent is separated from reimbursements and other income.
Recurring expenses and landlord obligations under net leases are captured.
Financing costs and one-time items are distinguishable.
Amounts reconcile with leases, rent roll and entity financials without double counting.

title: Lease agreements & amendments
purpose: Verify enforceable tenancy terms and landlord obligations.
period: All current executed leases and amendments
criteria: All parties, premises and lease terms are identified.
Required signatures and all amendments are included.
Rent, renewal/termination rights and expense responsibilities reconcile with underwriting.

title: Debt service evidence
purpose: Support principal and interest obligations used in repayment analysis.
period: Current obligations and requested historical periods
criteria: Creditor, borrower, balance and payment obligations are identifiable.
Principal and interest are distinguished from other charges.
Amounts reconcile with the debt schedule and underwriting period.

title: Mortgage statement / payoff
purpose: Identify and settle the existing debt being refinanced.
period: Most recent statement; payoff valid through closing when requested
criteria: Correct borrower, collateral and loans are identified.
Balances, payments and maturity reconcile with the application.
Required payoff covers closing date, fees and per-diem interest.
